program_name: Master's Degree in Administration, Finance, and Control

majors_language.major: Administration, Finance, and Control - specialization in Financial Statements, Control, and Business Consulting (Financial Reporting, Control and Business Consulting)

campus: Rome, Italy - Luiss Guido Carli. [uncertain] The programme page does not name a specific building for this course. Circumstantial evidence: Luiss states the Viale Romania 32 campus houses the Departments of Economics and Management and of Economics and Finance (the natural home of an Economics-area LM-77 programme), but this was not confirmed as this specific programme's teaching location.

admission_type.eligible_applicants: EU-Schengen and non-EU/non-Schengen candidates (separate admission notices for each group)
admission_type.test_or_certification: Luiss Test (psycho-aptitude/logical-reasoning/problem-solving/mathematics style test); English B2 (CEFR) level assessed for the English-taught major
admission_type.number_of_choices_allowed: Up to two master's degree courses within the same subject area
admission_type.application_fee: EUR 150 (non-refundable) - confirmed on both the EU/Schengen and non-EU/non-Schengen Luiss Test admission pages

admission_type.test_or_certification: GMAT >=515/805 OR GRE >=154/170 in both Verbal and Quantitative sections

academic_requirements.prior_qualification: Bachelor's degree (three-year first-level degree), obtained or to be obtained by the stated degree-completion deadline (18 November 2027 for the 2027/2028 EU/Schengen cycle)
academic_requirements.minimum_curricular_requirements: Direct admission for graduates of Italian degree classes L-18 (MD 270/04) / L-17 (MD 509/99) - Economics and Business Management, and L-33 (MD 270/04) / L-28 (MD 509/99) - Economics. Alternative pathway for other degree classes: at least 24 university credits (earned or pending) across at least three of: Business (SECS-P/07, 08, 09, 10, 11), Economics (SECS-P/01, 06), Statistics (SECS-S/01, 03, 04, 06; MAT/05, 06), Law (IUS/01, 04, 05, 08, 09, 10, 13, 14).
academic_requirements.country_specific_rules: Not published per-country for this specific programme; the general Luiss foreign-qualifications policy (Lisbon Convention / ARDI / non-ARDI tiers, see document_recognition) is the only country-differentiated rule confirmed. [uncertain] whether Luiss also publishes a country-by-country minimum-grade table for this programme specifically.
academic_requirements.document_recognition: Tiered by the awarding country: (1) Lisbon Recognition Convention signatory countries - a Diploma Supplement per CIMEA guidance; (2) ARDI database countries - a CIMEA statement of verification OR an apostille of the diploma issued by the competent Italian Embassy/Consulate; (3) non-ARDI/non-Lisbon countries - a CIMEA statement of comparability OR a Declaration of Value of the Diploma issued by the competent Italian Embassy/Consulate. Enrolment can be finalized 'conditionally' while the CIMEA procedure is still in progress.
academic_requirements.compensatory_measures: [uncertain] Luiss's foreign-qualifications guidance references that candidates whose qualification differs from the standard requirements 'may be subject to compensatory measures' to comply with enrolment requirements, but the exact verbatim wording and the specific measures (extra exams, a foundation year, etc.) could not be retrieved and re-confirmed with a direct quote in this pass.

language_requirements.required_level: B2 CEFR in English (for the English-taught major / English-taken Luiss Test)
language_requirements.accepted_certificates: Certification of at least B2 CEFR issued no more than three years previously is required in general; Luiss automatically assigns B2 to candidates whose prior schooling was conducted entirely in English. Higher levels earn admission-score bonus points (C1: +15 points; C2: +30 points) if a certificate is submitted. [uncertain] The exact list of accepted test names and minimum scores (e.g., IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 78-80, Cambridge FCE/CAE) quoted in the outline was not independently re-confirmed via a direct verbatim quote for this specific master's programme in this research pass.
language_requirements.exemptions: Automatic B2 assignment if prior schooling was conducted entirely in English (no certificate required to reach B2, only to claim a higher level for bonus points). [uncertain] Whether holders of a valid TOEFL/IELTS score can skip the English component of the Luiss Test itself (as opposed to just proving B2) was not confirmed specifically for this master's-level route; a similar exemption mechanism was found in Luiss materials but its applicability to this exact admission route is unverified.

application_deadline_eu.cycle_status: Preliminary dates published under the EU/Schengen Luiss Test and GMAT/GRE direct-admission pages (still hosted under URLs labelled '2026/2027'); the full official 2027/2028 admission notice is expected from November 2026 per Luiss's own general master's-admissions page.

application_deadline_non_eu.visa_or_preenrolment_notes: [uncertain] Not retrieved for this specific programme/cycle. Luiss's general non-EU admissions overview describes three separate procedures (Luiss Test; Finance & Management selection; admission with international qualifications) but does not detail Universitaly pre-enrolment or visa steps on the pages checked in this pass.
application_deadline_non_eu.cycle_status: Full 2027/2028 non-EU admission notices are described as 'coming soon', to be published from November 2026; separately, the 2026/2027 direct-admission-with-certifications procedure for non-EU students is stated as 'now closed'.

entry_exam_or_test.test_name: Luiss Test (or alternatively GMAT/GRE for direct admission)
entry_exam_or_test.content: [uncertain] General Luiss admission-test materials describe a 75-minute, 50-question multiple-choice test of psycho-aptitude, logical-reasoning, problem-solving and mathematics content (SAT-inspired), each correct answer worth 1 point and each wrong answer -0.25, minimum passing score 60/100 - but this description was found in materials primarily addressed to bachelor's/single-cycle admissions and was not independently re-confirmed as identical for this master's programme's Luiss Test.
entry_exam_or_test.format: Confirmed 'conducted online and remotely' for the non-EU/non-Schengen Luiss Test route; [uncertain] whether the EU/Schengen route uses the same online/remote format was not explicitly stated on the EU/Schengen test page fetched in this pass.
entry_exam_or_test.dates: 19-22 April 2027 (Luiss Test, both EU/Schengen and non-EU/non-Schengen routes, 2027/2028 preliminary)
entry_exam_or_test.language_of_test: Taking the test in English gives access to both English- and Italian-taught majors; taking it in Italian gives access only to the Italian-taught major (Financial Statements, Control, and Business Consulting).
entry_exam_or_test.interview: [uncertain] Not confirmed for the standard Luiss Test or GMAT/GRE route for this programme; a personal-interview requirement tied to English/Logic-test score exemptions was found in other Luiss admission materials but its applicability to this specific route was not verified.

tuition_or_fees_link.annual_amount: EUR 15,000.00 per year (payable in three instalments, plus the Lazio regional student welfare tax), confirmed directly on the programme page. Note: a separate FAQ block on the non-EU/non-Schengen Luiss Test admission page states a conflicting figure of EUR 16,000 for 'most programs' (mislabelling master's programmes as 'Bachelor's degree programmes'); per the outline's guidance, the EUR 15,000 programme-page figure is treated as authoritative and the EUR 16,000 figure as a conflicting secondary source.
